summary: Coordination adds an explicitly partial receiver admission precursor using copied input bytes, immutable transcript snapshots, purpose-bound pending challenges and no-effect reducers. Source-only v2 draft records share the existing execution journal key and lock, retain v1 readers and preserve original pins, challenge history and holds within bounded accounting. Disk staging and restart report durability Unknown; ACK preparation and production host handoff always refuse. The source adapter provides interpreted claims, not a qualified exact-envelope authenticator. Exact-envelope provenance and original-byte joins, ACK checkpoint semantics, durable crash-cut admission, once-only production handoff and complete replay/v1 matrices remain open. Source delivery and pure/fake tests cannot establish an authenticated unattended host endpoint, installed allocation/launch/teardown or worker-loss recovery, native acceptance or retirement of earlier operations. The unattended installed-lifecycle acceptance boundary remains unchanged.
title: V3 receiver admission draft is inert source, not installed authority
